newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Kiwi portfolio buy trimmed to NZ$91.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Kiwi portfolio buy trimmed to NZ$91.5 mln.

text.p: Kiwi Income Property Trust said on Wednesday that a Queen St, Auckland property had been removed from a portfolio it intends to buy from Sentry Investments Ltd, and the total purchase price had therefore fallen to NZ$91.5 million from $130 million.
This was because Queen and Wyndham Management Ltd, which owns half of the property at 151 Queen St, had exercised its right of pre-emption over Sentry's half-interest.
The purchase of the remaining four properties in the Sentry portfolio is subject to the approval of Kiwi unit holders at an extraordinary general meeting on November 6.
